author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

Sugar Tangerines are at their sweetest in deep winter—delicate and melt-in-the-mouth, with thin skins and plump flesh. One bite and the juice bursts in your mouth. Lamb, too, is at its best in winter: rich but not greasy, lean yet tender, with a gentle milky aroma and just the right chew.
So let’s eat them both. Eating together is what truly satisfies. When you’ve had a bit too much meat, peel a Sugar Tangerine, then go back for a few more bites of lamb. Back and forth like this, before you know it, the lamb is gone—and so are the tangerines.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
